```
module school.grading
  purpose: Turn scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades A to F and count how many students got each grade.

public type Score is Integer where value is at least 0 and value is at most 100
  purpose: A score between 0 and 100 inclusive.

public type Grade is one of
  GradeA
  GradeB
  GradeC
  GradeD
  GradeF
end

public type GradeCount
  purpose: The number of students who received one grade.
  has grade: Grade
  has total: Integer where total is at least 0
end

public function grade_for(score: Score)
  returns Grade
  purpose: Convert one score to a grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  example: grade_for(Score(95)) is GradeA
  example: grade_for(Score(90)) is GradeA
  example: grade_for(Score(89)) is GradeB
  example: grade_for(Score(70)) is GradeC
  example: grade_for(Score(65)) is GradeD
  example: grade_for(Score(12)) is GradeF

  let grade be if score is at least 90 then GradeA otherwise if score is at least 80 then GradeB otherwise if score is at least 70 then GradeC otherwise if score is at least 60 then GradeD otherwise GradeF end
  return grade
end

public function letter(grade: Grade)
  returns Text
  purpose: Give the one-letter name of a grade.
  tags: grading
  example: letter(GradeA) is "A"
  example: letter(GradeF) is "F"

  match grade
    when GradeA then return "A"
    when GradeB then return "B"
    when GradeC then return "C"
    when GradeD then return "D"
    when GradeF then return "F"
  end
end

public function grades_for(scores: List of Score)
  returns List of Grade
  purpose: Convert every score in the list to a grade, keeping the order.
  tags: grading
  example: grades_for([Score(95), Score(55)]) is [GradeA, GradeF]

  return for each score in scores collect grade_for(score)
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Score)
  returns List of GradeCount
  purpose: Count how many students got each grade, listed from A to F, including grades nobody received.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grades_for
  example: count_grades([Score(95)]) is [GradeCount(grade: GradeA, total: 1), GradeCount(grade: GradeB, total: 0), GradeCount(grade: GradeC, total: 0), GradeCount(grade: GradeD, total: 0), GradeCount(grade: GradeF, total: 0)]

  let grades be grades_for(scores)
  let count_a be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeA count
  let count_b be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeB count
  let count_c be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeC count
  let count_d be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeD count
  let count_f be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeF count
  return [GradeCount(grade: GradeA, total: count_a), GradeCount(grade: GradeB, total: count_b), GradeCount(grade: GradeC, total: count_c), GradeCount(grade: GradeD, total: count_d), GradeCount(grade: GradeF, total: count_f)]
end

test "cut-offs fall on the right side"
  check grade_for(Score(90)) is GradeA
  check grade_for(Score(80)) is GradeB
  check grade_for(Score(79)) is GradeC
  check grade_for(Score(60)) is GradeD
  check grade_for(Score(59)) is GradeF
end
```

```
module school.grading
  purpose: Turn numeric scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades and count how many students earned each grade.

public type ScoreError is one of
  OutOfRange(score: Integer)
  purpose: The ways a score can be rejected.
end

public function letter_grade(score: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Convert one score from 0 to 100 into a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  example: letter_grade(95) is "A"
  example: letter_grade(80) is "B"
  example: letter_grade(79) is "C"
  example: letter_grade(60) is "D"
  example: letter_grade(59) is "F"

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with OutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return "A"
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return "B"
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return "C"
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return "D"
  otherwise
    return "F"
  end
end

public function letter_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Convert every score in a list into its letter grade, keeping the original order.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grade
  example: letter_grades([95, 85, 72, 65, 10]) is ["A", "B", "C", "D", "F"]

  let grades be
    for each score in scores
    collect letter_grade(score) otherwise fail
  return grades
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns Map of Text to Integer
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade; every grade from A to F appears in the result, even with a count of zero.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: letter_grades
  example: count_grades([95, 91, 85, 40]) is {"A": 2, "B": 1, "C": 0, "D": 0, "F": 1}

  let grades be letter_grades(scores) otherwise fail
  let mutable counts be {"A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0, "D": 0, "F": 0}
  for each grade in grades
    let current be counts.get(grade) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: grade, value: current + 1)
  end
  return counts
end

test "cut-offs fall on the boundaries"
  check letter_grade(90) is "A"
  check letter_grade(89) is "B"
  check letter_grade(70) is "C"
  check letter_grade(0) is "F"
  check letter_grade(100) is "A"
end

test "grades are counted per letter"
  check count_grades([100, 90, 80, 70, 60, 50]) is {"A": 2, "B": 1, "C": 1, "D": 1, "F": 1}
end
```

```
  let mutable grades: List of Grade be []

    let grade be grade_for(score) otherwise fail
    set grades to grades.append(grade)
  end
  return grades
end

public function letter_for(grade: Grade)
  returns Text
  purpose: Give the letter that names a grade.
  tags: grading
  example: letter_for(GradeB) is "B"

  match grade
    when GradeA then return "A"
    when GradeB then return "B"
    when GradeC then return "C"
    when GradeD then return "D"
    when GradeF then return "F"
  end

  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Count how many students earned each letter grade; fails if any score is outside 0 to 100.

  example: count_grades([95, 91, 85, 72, 40]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 1, c_count: 1, d_count: 0, f_count: 1)

  let a_total be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeA count

  let f_total be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeF count
  return GradeCounts(a_count: a_total, b_count: b_total, c_count: c_total, d_count: d_total, f_count: f_total)

test "cut-offs fall on the right side"
  check grade_for(90) is GradeA
  check grade_for(89) is GradeB
  check grade_for(80) is GradeB
  check grade_for(79) is GradeC
  check grade_for(60) is GradeD
  check grade_for(0) is GradeF
end

test "counts add up per grade"
  check count_grades([100, 90, 80, 70, 60, 59]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 1, c_count: 1, d_count: 1, f_count: 1)
```

```
module school.grading
  purpose: Turn numeric scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades and count how many students earned each grade.

public type LetterGrade is one of

  GradeB
  GradeC
  GradeD
  GradeF
end

public type GradeError is one of
  ScoreOutOfRange(score: Integer)
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: How many students received each letter grade.
  has grade_a: Integer
  has grade_b: Integer
  has grade_c: Integer
  has grade_d: Integer
  has grade_f: Integer
end

public function grade_for(score: Integer)
  returns LetterGrade
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Convert one score into a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: grades_for
  example: grade_for(95) is GradeA
  example: grade_for(80) is GradeB
  example: grade_for(79) is GradeC
  example: grade_for(60) is GradeD
  example: grade_for(12) is GradeF

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with ScoreOutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return GradeD
  otherwise
    return GradeF
  end
end

public function grades_for(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of LetterGrade
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Convert every score in the list into a letter grade, keeping the original order.
  tags: grading
  see also: grade_for
  example: grades_for([95, 85, 42]) is [GradeA, GradeB, GradeF]

  let mutable grades: List of LetterGrade be []
  for each score in scores
    let grade be grade_for(score) otherwise fail
    set grades to grades.append(grade)
  end
  return grades
end

public function letter(grade: LetterGrade)
  returns Text
  purpose: Give the single-letter text for a grade.
  tags: grading
  example: letter(GradeA) is "A"
  example: letter(GradeF) is "F"

  match grade
    when GradeA then return "A"
    when GradeB then return "B"
    when GradeC then return "C"
    when GradeD then return "D"
    when GradeF then return "F"
  end
end

public function count_grades(grades: List of LetterGrade)
  returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: count_scores
  example: count_grades([GradeA, GradeA, GradeF]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 2, grade_b: 0, grade_c: 0, grade_d: 0, grade_f: 1)

  let total_a be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeA count
  let total_b be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeB count
  let total_c be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeC count
  let total_d be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeD count
  let total_f be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeF count
  return GradeCounts(grade_a: total_a, grade_b: total_b, grade_c: total_c, grade_d: total_d, grade_f: total_f)
end

public function count_scores(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeCounts
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Grade every score and count how many students received each letter grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: count_grades, grades_for
  example: count_scores([95, 91, 85, 70, 65, 10]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 2, grade_b: 1, grade_c: 1, grade_d: 1, grade_f: 1)

  let grades be grades_for(scores) otherwise fail
  return count_grades(grades)
end

test "cut-offs fall on the higher grade"
  check grade_for(90) is GradeA
  check grade_for(89) is GradeB
  check grade_for(70) is GradeC
  check grade_for(59) is GradeF
end

test "scores outside the range are rejected"
  match grade_for(101)
    when success(grade) then crash with "expected a failure, got {letter(grade)}"
    when failure(error) then check error is ScoreOutOfRange(score: 101)
  end
end
```
